title: Model context registry, real token counting and budget allocation
description: Replace byte-based estimates with real token counts (tiktoken for hosted models, calibrated runtime ratios for local models), give every model a context window, output and thinking allowance and working cap, and allocate budgets across instructions, evidence, summary, recent turns and recall. Send real multi-turn message lists through both providers, with a stable prefix that benefits prompt caching.
acceptance_criteria: Given an 8k local model and a hosted model, when a prompt is assembled, then its counted tokens never exceed the model's input budget.
Given the same question, when assembled under the new counter, then substantially more evidence fits than under byte counting.
Given a local model with thinking enabled, when generating, then thinking cannot consume the answer's allowance.
Given hosted and local providers, when a chat request is built, then both receive a role-separated message list with prior assistant citations rendered as page references.
test_cases: TokenCounter accuracy against reference counts; allocator property tests; provider request-shape tests for Responses and Ollama chat.
